candidates.change_summary: Replace the overflow-checked increment condition with an always-failing require to prevent depositsCount from increasing.
Remove the require entirely so depositsCount is always incremented on receive without any check.
Change the require condition to a stricter check that prevents increment when depositsCount is zero (i.e., require depositsCount > 0 before incrementing).
Invert the require condition so it requires the increment to overflow (impossible under normal arithmetic), blocking the increment.
Move the increment before the require check so depositsCount is increased even if the require would have failed (post-increment behavior).
Removed the onlyOwner guard from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, changing who can withdraw and thus observable balance/state after call.
Modified onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner (inverted check), so owner-only functions become callable by non-owners and blocked for owner, altering withdrawAll observable behavior.
Replace transfer with send (using return value and require) so withdraw uses .send instead of .transfer, changing failure behavior and gas forwarding.
Replace transfer with low-level call that forwards all gas and does not revert on failure (no require), changing observable outcome when transfer would have reverted.
Remove the require check in onlyOwner modifier so withdraw can be called by anyone, altering who can change balance observed after withdraw.
